consent.read: View the data your role allows you to see (tasks, projects, teams…).

connect.title: Connect an AI assistant
connect.description: Claude, ChatGPT and OAuth-compatible clients do not need a key: add the connector with the URL {url}, then sign in with your account. The keys below are for manually configured clients (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code…), always in the Authorization: Bearer … header: a key passed in the URL (?token=) is rejected. The assistant always acts with your permissions.
